blocks.label: clues
blocks.extractionHint: Exact testimony, contradicting details, lines of reasoning, and untested theories. Each lead's verification status lives in the Case Board dimension; do not repeat it here.

blocks.label: relics
blocks.extractionHint: Ancient relics obtained or seen, their appraisals, effects, risks, and ownership.

blocks.label: tides
blocks.extractionHint: Observations and rumors about ebb timing, fog-beast sightings, and safe/danger windows. The deep-withdrawal stage lives in the Deep Withdrawal dimension and the hero's fog-rot in character attributes; do not repeat them.

blocks.label: commitments
blocks.extractionHint: The story behind promises and deals made to the Council, Guild, Salt Fangs, and Congregation: who, for what, and on what terms. Attitude scores and permit/warrant/favor marks live in the Faction Standing dimension.
